messages:
alex.k: FYI I'm opening intake for a new candidate model (open-variant v0.9). Want to run quick prioritization + QA gate checklist before we schedule quant experiments. TL;DR: targeted for customer A (chat + code), hope to try AWQ int8 and default int4 flows.

maria.s: +1. can you paste the initial perf/size goals?

alex.k: goals: latency <120ms p50 on 8k context (batched qps=20), throughput ~250 tokens/s on g4dn-like; quality delta vs baseline (curated-prod) < 1.5% on our convo rubric; embedding similarity drop <0.7% for semantic search. storage target: <12GB int8, <6GB int4 (post-quant).

devin: sounds reasonable. for prioritization, is this replacing an existing model or new surface?

alex.k: replaces prod-small for customer A chat. Traffic swapped via canary and fallback to prod-small if quality regression detected.

priya: Suggest we run the following minimal gate sequence before any ded. capacity commit: 1) smoke inference on 50 prompts (sanity), 2) eval harness run (full convo suite ~2.5k prompts), 3) quantization delta checks (int8 + int4), 4) canary with 1% traffic and automatic rollback if A/B metric drop >2% absolute.

alex.k: Agreed. For step 2 we'll use eval harness v3.2. Command to run locally:
```
python -m eval_harness.run --model open-variant-v0.9 --suite convo_prod_curated --seed 42 --out /tmp/v0.9_run.json
```
Expect ~3-4h on our cluster.

maria.s: Add these explicit pass/fail thresholds to the gate doc:
- convorecall_delta <= 1.5% (lower=better)
- exact_match_delta <= 2.0%
- toxic_generation_rate <= baseline + 0.2%
- latency p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 320ms
- embedding_cos_sim_drop <= 0.7%

devin: Also add a qualitative spot-check: 50 convo examples reviewed by SE for hallucination/formatting. If 5+ flagged, fail.

priya: For quantization checks, we'll run AWQ-int8 then PTQ-int4. Checklist:
- run calibration with 1000 representative prompts
- measure perplexity delta on holdout (should be <3%)
- measure convo metrics above
- run KV-cache smoke for long context (8k) to validate memory behavior

alex.k: I'll start a Drive doc and share. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-doc-v09 (working doc).

sam-bot: CI: triggered eval job #7845 for open-variant-v0.9 (eval_harness v3.2). Logs: https://ci.internal/job/7845/logs

maria.s: Quick question on sampling: use temperature 0.2 for convo eval, and decoding topk=40/top_p=0.95?

devin: We usually do temp=0.0 for deterministic metrics, but keep a small temp (0.2) for robustness. For the gate, run both deterministic and stochastic sets: deterministic for core metrics, stochastic for behavior fuzziness.

alex.k: noted. Also adding rollout strategy: canary rollout at 1% for 24h with targeted eval hooks. If no automatic rollback, expand to 10% for 12h, then 50% for 6h, full.

priya: Observability checklist before canary:
- model-level traces enabled
- latency SLO monitors + alerting on p95 spike
- perf counters (batch sizes, queue length) exported
- prompt/response sampling to S3 for drift analysis (retain 30d)

maria.s: Who owns the canary monitor? assign @devin?

devin: I'll own the monitor + rollback runbook.

alex.k: Action items: 1) alex.k: create intake doc + initial eval runs (today) 2) maria.s: add gate thresholds to doc (today) 3) devin: configure canary monitor + runbook (tomorrow) 4) priya: schedule quant experiments and baseline calibrations (this week).

maria.s: small note — include sample sizes for the gating metrics: convo suite = 2500 prompts, embedding holdout = 10k pairs, smoke = 50, qualitative = 50.

alex.k: good call. I'll update doc. Also capturing quick CLI for AWQ quant run for reproducibility:
```
python -m quant.awq.convert --model-path /mnt/models/open-variant-v0.9 --out-path /mnt/quant/open-v0.9-awq-int8 --calib-set /data/calib/1k_prompts.json --seed 2026
```

priya: one more: add a gating condition on model size artifact hash + provenance file (must include training data snapshot + tokenizer version). No blind artifacts.

devin: +1. Also ensure rollbacks keep the same tokenization/stop sequences.

sam-bot: CI: eval job #7845 finished. summary: convo_recall_delta=1.2%, exact_match_delta=1.8%, latency_p50=110ms, embedding_drop=0.45%. Artifacts: s3://ci-open/v0.9/eval-7845.json

maria.s: Sounds like it passes the initial harness metrics. schedule quant int8 next. :thumbsup:

alex.k: thanks team. I'll update intake doc and @everyone ping for canary readiness later this week.

priya: leaving a quick note in the doc about risk matrix: customer A is latency-sensitive, fallback must be <100ms regression. If canary increases median latency >15ms, abort.

devin: Logged the runbook PR: https://repo.internal/rollouts/pull/501

alex.k: closing thread for now, will re-open if any regressions show up.
